newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish futop turnover fell 52 percent in July.
newsitem.headline: Danish futop turnover fell 52 percent in July.

text.p: July futures and options turnover on Denmark's Futop Exchange fell 52 percent from June, to an average 1,829 contracts per day, the exchange said on Monday.
It said total turnover for July was 42,068 compared to 76,089 in June.
At the same time total trade in bond-based contracts fell 78 percent to an average 527 contracts per day, it said.
Equity-based contracts fell three percent to 28,061 for the month of July, an average of 1,220 contracts per day, the exchange said. --Ole Mikkelsen, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
